title_en: Course Registration for the 2026 Academic Year Winter Session
summary: Students who wish to take courses in the winter session of the 2026 academic year must read the attached files and register for courses according to the published schedule. The schedule and precautions are not included in the text of the notice; they appear to be in the attachments or images, which were not read. Please consult the attachments or the original notice for dates and the registration location or system.
applies_to: Students who wish to apply for the winter session (동계 계절학기) of the 2026 academic year. The notice does not state any further limit by program, year of admission or nationality. Registration is required only for students who wish to take winter session courses.
conditions: Students must register according to the official schedule; the schedule itself is not in the notice text and must be checked in the attachments.
The notice lists headings for a schedule (1. 일정) and precautions (2. 유의사항), but their content is not in the text and was not read.

Attachments on course registration misconduct, on changes to the registration system to prevent course reselling, and on overlapping course registration requests were not read; students should read them because they may contain further rules.
steps: Read Attachment 1-1, the Guideline for 2026 Winter Session Course Registration, to find the registration schedule and precautions.

Read the other attachments: the Seoul National University course registration system user manual (Korean and English), the card news on the new course registration program for preventing reselling, the notice on course registration misconduct, and the Course Overlap Request Manual.
Register for winter session courses through the course registration system within the schedule stated in Attachment 1-1.
If you have questions, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Course Registration for the 2026 Academic Year Winter Session

We announce the course registration schedule for the winter session of the 2026 academic year. Students who wish to apply for the winter session should read the attached files carefully and apply according to the schedule.

1. Schedule

2. Precautions

(Note: the content under these two headings is not included in the text of the notice. It may be in an image or in the attachments, which were not read.)

Attachment 1-2. Seoul National University Course Registration System User Manual (Korean and English)
Attachment 1-3. Card news on the improved course registration system for preventing course reselling
Attachment 2. Notice on course registration misconduct
Attachment 3. Guide to overlapping course registration (중복수강신청)

(Attachment 1-2) 서울대학교 수강신청 시스템 이용자 매뉴얼(국영문) (Seoul National University Course Registration System User Manual, Korean/English).pdf (25 MB)
(Attachment 1-3) 강의매매방지 수강신청제도 개선 카드뉴스 (New CRS Program for Preventing Reselling).pdf (3 MB)
(Attachment 2) 수강신청 부정행위 관련 알림 (Notice on Course Registration Misconduct).pdf (55 KB)
